description:
605 W Washington AVE, Copperas Cove TX 
Discover this newly updated, spacious home. It features a new HVAC system and renovated bathrooms. The kitchen is equipped with granite countertops, soft-close cabinets, and new appliances. The home boasts an open yet split floor plan. The master bathroom includes an expansive shower with two shower heads. There is no carpet; instead, the home has ceramic tile and high-quality vinyl plank flooring. Lower your electricity bill with new windows and an ECO Smart tankless water heater. The large backyard includes a new 10X16FT shed for ample storage. Please inquire about the various warranties that come with this home.
